description: Na₂Ga₂As₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one Ga and six As atoms. The Na-Ga bond length is 3.28 Å. There are a spread of Na-As bond distances ranging from 2.99-3.22 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five As atoms. There are a spread of Na-As bond distances ranging from 3.00-3.19 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ga and five As atoms. There is one shorter (3.08 Å) and one longer (3.22 Å) Na-Ga bond length. There are a spread of Na-As bond distances ranging from 3.05-3.29 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ga and five As atoms. There is one shorter (3.10 Å) and one longer (3.39 Å) Na-Ga bond length. There are a spread of Na-As bond distances ranging from 2.86-3.30 Å. There are four inequivalent Ga sites. In the first Ga site, Ga is bonded to four As atoms to form distorted corner-sharing GaAs₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ga-As bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.60 Å. In the second Ga site, Ga is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and four As atoms. There are a spread of Ga-As bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.50 Å. In the third Ga site, Ga is bonded to one Na and four As atoms to form distorted GaNaAs₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two AsNa₄Ga₃ pentagonal bipyramids and corners with two equivalent GaAs₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ga-As bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.54 Å. In the fourth Ga site, Ga is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and four As atoms. There are a spread of Ga-As bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.54 Å. There are six inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na and three Ga atoms. In the second As site, As is bonded to four Na and three Ga atoms to form distorted AsNa₄Ga₃ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one GaNaAs₄ tetrahedra and edges with three AsNa₄Ga₃ pentagonal bipyramids. In the third As site, As is bonded to four Na and three Ga atoms to form distorted AsNa₄Ga₃ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one GaNaAs₄ tetrahedra and edges with three AsNa₄Ga₃ pentagonal bipyramids. In the fourth As site, As is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four Na, two Ga, and one As atom. The As-As bond length is 2.49 Å. In the fifth As site, As is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na and three Ga atoms. In the sixth As site, As is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, two Ga, and one As atom.
